deferrals.name: mcp
deferrals.reason: openhands-sdk 1.53.0 requires fastmcp>=3.2.0,<4, which requires mcp<2.0. Defer MCP 2.x until a supported SDK/fastmcp release removes that constraint.

deferrals.name: OSS_CAD_SUITE_RELEASE
deferrals.reason: The pinned suite tarball vendors python2.7/python3.11 site-packages carrying 6 upstream-borne CVEs (9 Trivy findings) that no in-repo change can fix; they are waived in .trivyignore until 2027-01-03. On the next OSS_CAD_SUITE_RELEASE bump, re-scan the image and drop the waivers that upstream's rebuilt pythons cleared.

deferrals.name: uv
deferrals.reason: 0.12.22 is the version the family-wide snapshot rebuild standardized on this wave (required-version in pyproject.toml and the workflow bootstrap); a same-day 0.12.23 release needs an upstream changelog review and a coordinated bump across repos, not a lone-repo edit.

deferrals.name: UV_VERSION
deferrals.reason: Dockerfile UV_VERSION must move with the pyproject required-version pin; deferred with the uv-pin entry pending a coordinated family bump of 0.12.22.

deferrals.name: actions/cache
deferrals.reason: v6 is a brand-new major of actions/cache; the trivy DB cache in container-audit.yml works on v4.3.0. Bump family-wide after an upstream changelog review of the v5/v6 breaking changes.
